title: Context Correction Retry QA
principle: After fixing bad context, the next useful action should be to retry the visible answer path with the corrected source state.
public_repo_rule: Retry receipts store only metadata, prompt character count, correction IDs and answer IDs. They do not store raw prompts, raw responses, provider secrets or paid-route approvals.

scenarios.expected: Assistant answers with a matching context correction get a Retry fixed action after deferred hydration.
The retry action derives the prompt from the visible chat transcript instead of storing a hidden raw prompt in the correction receipt.
Retry attempts write a local receipt with correction ID, target, prompt length and no raw prompt or response.
The retried assistant answer is marked as corrected-context output when the next visible answer arrives.
